summary: Refresh curated model lineup: sonnet-4.6 → sonnet-5, gpt-5.4 → gpt-5.6-terra, add google/gemini-3.6-flash
description: Three pure config bumps, no product changes. Swaps: anthropic → anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 ($2/$10 cached $0.20 — cheaper AND newer than 4.6, ~4 q/day up from 2); openai → openai/gpt-5.6-terra ($2.50/$15 cached $0.25 — same price as 5.4, current gen). Add: google slug → google/gemini-3.6-flash ($1.50/$7.50 cached $0.15, ~5 q/day) as fifth provider — needs new CURATED_MODELS + PROVIDER_META name/color + PREFERRED_PROVIDER entry (verify canonical name against /api/v1/models/google\/gemini-3.6-flash/endpoints; typos silently no-op due to allow_fallbacks). deepseek + xai slugs unchanged (v4-pro is current flagship; grok-4.5 costs ~2x for marginal bump). DECIDED AGAINST after evaluation 2026-07-25: free-tier alternate models (glm-5.2 / minimax-m3) — requires tier-aware picker gating for no revenue benefit; M3's benchmark edge is a reasoning-vs-non-reasoning artifact and its thinking mode risks citation truncation + 3x output cost; GLM at deepseek-parity volume violates the 50% margin floor. Checklist per slug: FALLBACK_PRICING row, npm run sync-pricing, coverage test green. Move sonnet-4.6/gpt-5.4 to the one-release safety-net section of FALLBACK_PRICING and drop deepseek-chat/sonnet-4.5 rows (note: deepseek-chat live price is now $0.20/$0.80, stale in repo, but row is being deleted anyway).

resolution.note: Lineup refreshed: sonnet-5 ($2/$10), gpt-5.6-terra, new google slug → gemini-3.6-flash pinned to 'Google AI Studio' (verified via endpoints API). FALLBACK_PRICING rows match live OpenRouter rates; sync-pricing run against local db — all three new ids have open model_pricing rows. 697 tests green incl. updated coverage/display/api contract tests. Run sync-pricing on the VPS at deploy (or wait for the daily timer) before flipping traffic.
